# Plan: Include an API version header

## Goal
`respond(body)` returns `{ status: 200, body, headers: { "X-API-Version": "1" } }`. `status` and `body` keep their values.

## Design
- `lib/respond.mjs`: add the `headers` field with the literal `"1"` (string, per the task text) under key `X-API-Version`.
- Test impact: the existing test deep-equals the exact shape `{ status: 200, body: "x" }`, so it must be updated to include the new `headers` field; I'll keep a direct assertion that `status === 200` and `body === "x"` still hold, pinning the "keep status and body" requirement explicitly.

## Changes
1. `lib/respond.mjs` — add the headers field.
2. `tests/respond.test.mjs` — update the deepEqual expectation to the three-field shape; add explicit status/body assertions.

## Order of work
1. Modify `lib/respond.mjs`.
2. Update the test.
3. Run `node --test`; suite must pass.

## Done when
- `respond("x")` → `{ status: 200, body: "x", headers: { "X-API-Version": "1" } }`.
- status and body values unchanged and pinned by assertions.
- Tests updated and green.
